overall_assessment: AHO generally preserves top-level section boundaries and learning-outcome groups, and several controls correctly separate coursework gates from assessment, but controls also show incomplete prerequisites, misfiled teaching and coursework, and retained exam logistics. Design Studio's learning-outcome leak is real, and VALG3's blob reflects a long description that also contains teaching methods with no separate output row. The empty flag on the two prerequisite course codes and the four long flags on two bibliographies and two substantive prerequisite rows are length-based false alarms.

findings.description: The uncapped Design Studio row confirms that the Service Design track's LEARNING OUTCOMES, COURSE ACTIVITIES and EVALUATION text remains under course_content. The course-level outcome, teaching and assessment rows omit this track-specific material.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The AHO HTML reader recognizes the outer Course description heading. The labelled track passages stay inside its text block.
findings.suggested_fix: Extend the AHO section splitter to recognize line-leading LEARNING OUTCOMES, COURSE ACTIVITIES and EVALUATION labels inside track descriptions, and route their text to the matching sections with the original track context. Treat each new numbered track and COURSE CONTENT label as a boundary.

findings.evidence: Kurset er lagt opp som et verkstedkurs for koding, hvor studentene øves i teknologiske verktøy og ferdigheter.
findings.description: Teaching descriptions embedded in prose stay in course_content. VALG3 has no teaching_methods row despite workshop, lecture and exercise descriptions, and its Formnerd capability statement also stays in course_content. Interaction Design 2's module and workshop format sentence and Diploma's appointed-supervisor sentence remain in course_content alongside populated teaching rows.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Heading-based extraction preserves unlabelled prose under the mapped heading without recognizing semantic changes inside it.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an AHO rule to move complete delivery sentences with observed leads such as Kurset er lagt opp som et verkstedkurs, The semester is structured around and Each student has one main appointed supervisor from course_content to teaching_methods, creating the row if needed. Route Formnerd's explicit Målet er at studentene gjennom fire uker skal utvikle sentence to learning_outcomes and retain the source track labels for moved text.

findings.evidence: 2 year international master students must have been accepted for interaction design courses, and have taken Interaction Design 1.
findings.description: Interaction Design 2 preserves the 180-ECTS requirement but drops the explicit Interaction Design 1 requirement for international master students and the prior GK5/GK6 specialization requirement for AHO students. The latter appears in a sentence that also states admission priorities.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The .admission heading is mapped correctly. In .admission_prerequisites(), the positive matcher misses prior-study wording such as have taken with a spelled-out course title, and the priority exclusion can discard a sentence containing an independent prior-specialization clause.
findings.suggested_fix: Recognize have taken plus a named prior course, and must have chosen plus a named specialization and GK course references, in AHO access blocks. Preserve the sentence combining international eligibility with prior coursework, and retain the independent specialization clause before the admission-priority clauses.

findings.evidence: The student must submit all assignments in the course to receive final assessment.
findings.description: Digital Commons leaves an explicit submission gate inside the assessment comment and emits no coursework_requirements row. The adjacent evaluation of project quality and participation describes the graded assessment.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The English condition matcher in .gate_sentence_regex does not cover the direct infinitive to receive final assessment.
findings.suggested_fix: Recognize must submit or complete assignments to receive final assessment as a gate sentence in .split_inline_coursework(). Move only that sentence to coursework_requirements and keep the evaluation criteria in assessment.

findings.evidence:
Assignments

Preparation of Reading list. Minimum 50 titles by January 14, 2026
findings.description: Apparatus: Reading extracts the directive to attend workshops, complete assignments and join the final presentation. The adjacent list specifying the required reading list, annotated bibliography, literature review and presentation remains in teaching_methods.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: In teaching blocks, .split_inline_coursework() treats Assignments as a general teaching label even after a compulsory-activities block explicitly requiring those assignments.
findings.suggested_fix: In AHO teaching blocks, carry an immediately following Assignments heading and its items into coursework_requirements when the preceding compulsory-activities block explicitly requires assignment completion. Stop at the next unrelated heading.

findings.evidence: Hjemmeeksamen: Fem timers skriftlig hjemmeeksamen i Wiseflow. Alle hjelpemidler tillatt.
findings.description: Otherwise substantive assessment rows retain exam-system wording, examiner arrangements and submission timing. The history exam includes its delivery platform, Interaction Design 2 retains an external-examiner notice and a failed-module resubmission window, and Studietur retains a deadline measured from the last seminar.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The AHO patterns in .logistics_sentences cover selected standalone WISEflow and deadline notices. These variants and the platform phrase embedded in an assessment-design sentence survive.
findings.suggested_fix: Strip the AHO exam-system suffix i Wiseflow within the exam-form sentence, preserving the five-hour duration and permitted aids. Add narrow assessment cleanup for standalone examiner notices, the timing clause in the failed-module notice and the Innlevering av eksamen er ... etter ... deadline sentence.

findings.evidence: The students will need to buy materials. Depending on what you already have available, the expenses will be about 1500-3000,-.
findings.description: Otherwise substantive teaching rows retain material expenses and excursion payment arrangements. Design Studio retains track capacity lines inside course_content.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: AHO's cleanup leaves these cost sentences and track-capacity lines inside mapped prose blocks.
findings.suggested_fix: Extend the AHO cleanup to strip the observed material-purchase and excursion-payment sentences and standalone Max amount of students lines. Preserve the descriptions of the materials-based teaching, the excursion and the design tracks.

findings.evidence: The course is organized through dialogue-driven seminars/workshops in which the discussions centre on each candidate’s research topics, methods, and challenges.
findings.description: The plan repeats this teaching-method sentence verbatim under Course description and Teaching, and the extractor carries it into both course_content and teaching_methods.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Heading-based extraction preserves the two copies in rows whose full texts differ, so row-level deduplication cannot resolve the repeated sentence.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the exact normalized seminar/workshop sentence from course_content when the same full sentence is already present in teaching_methods. Retain its verbatim teaching_methods copy.
